note: System 3 Lessons' features, for the city HQ's Features page (tools/hq/hq-dashboard.mjs reads it into the dashboard's `features`). Status is one of live (in production), building (code or lessons exist, not in production or switched off there), planned (a decision or PRD, nothing built), retired. One owner per feature (PRINCIPLES.md P5). Owner of this file: tools-lead; a feature's owner corrects its own line. Checked against the code and company/ops/releases.json on 2026-10-25.

features.title: The lesson feed
features.summary: A vertical feed of 60-second predict, explore, reveal cards, filterable by subject, paged from a slim index (EDD-001)

features.title: Lane S: single-card lessons
features.summary: Single-card lessons across 14 subject folders, each fact-checked, QA'd and walked by a learner evaluator before it is published; 720 published, 234 in review and 692 in draft on 2026-10-25, shown with their status label

features.title: Publish gates
features.summary: A lesson is published only past the company CLI's gates: claims verified by someone other than the builder, QA, the learner walk and the launch review

features.title: Lane M: multi-card sequences
features.summary: Lessons of 2 to 4 sub-cards in the kit's CardSequence; one warm maker per item (F-52 G1). The first, math/euclid-three-steps, was published on 2026-10-25 and has not yet gone out in a production release; math/flatten-the-cube-to-a-dot is in draft

features.title: The map of subjects
features.summary: The feed's Map (/catalog): what we teach and what we do not teach yet, each subject's curriculum concepts with the lessons that teach them

features.title: Interactive history atlas
features.summary: History told on maps: 24 map stories in eight families, four checkpoints each, labelled a draft collection (releases r20, r21)

features.title: Progress and spaced revisits
features.summary: Progress is kept in the learner's browser, with no account; the feed brings lessons back later and asks before it shows

features.title: Anonymous event beacon
features.summary: Anonymous lesson events (start, predict, reveal) to the event API, origin-checked; NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENTS=off turns it off

features.title: Accounts and server progress
features.summary: Optional sign-in, progress synced to the server with a merge screen, export and delete (EDD-008). In production as code since r10, switched off: ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is off, so every /api/account route answers 404

features.title: Likes, saves and the library
features.summary: Like and save a lesson and find it in the Library; behind LIKES_SAVES_ENABLED and LIKE_COUNTS_PUBLIC, both off in production; PRD-005 is proposed

features.title: Feed preferences and the personalised order
features.summary: Account-saved feed preferences (edit, off, reset) and the personalised lesson order; needs accounts, and NEXT_PUBLIC_NEW_LESSON_ORDER is off in production, so the feed keeps the default order

features.title: HQ (in the app)
features.summary: The company's operating picture at /hq: lessons and gates, board, rituals, strategy, curriculum, design, evaluation, R&D, First Light, kudos, the whiteboard and the release log

features.title: City HQ adapters
features.summary: The company in the System 3 city: org, building, events, dashboard (with principles, features and releases), knowledge and docs through read-only tools; Meta builds the snapshot from tools/hq/hq-city.json

features.title: Release log
features.summary: Every production deploy recorded with its commit, notes and who approved it (or 'not recorded'); deploys need the founder's approval every time

features.title: First Light, release 1
features.summary: The first public release: accounts, progress, legal, infrastructure, mastery, rule-based personalization and share-a-lesson; go/no-go on 2026-11-23

features.title: Challenges and the prediction swap
features.summary: Challenges (cut to First Light release 2 unless feature-complete on a preview by 2026-11-06) and a social prediction swap; both PRDs are proposed, nothing approved
